exercises.title: Food & Eating Out — Reading
exercises.passage: Ella and her family visit a small café on Saturdays. Ella usually orders soup as a starter and pasta as a main course. Today the café has a new vegetable dish with fresh ingredients. Ella tries it and asks for the recipe.

questions.question: What does Ella usually order as a starter?
What does she ask for today?

exercises.title: Food & Eating Out — Listening
exercises.script: Waiter: Are you ready to order? Guest: Yes, we would like two salads and some water. Waiter: Would you like dessert? Guest: Not today, thank you. Could we have the bill later?
